## Frequently Asked Questions


### How do I get a promo code for TikTok Shop?


TikTok Shop promo codes come from the coupon area in the app, the product listing, or seller promotions shown on the item page. There is no universal code confirmed to work for every shopper, so check offers in your own account and confirm the discount appears in your checkout total before paying.


### How do I get a 50% off coupon on TikTok Shop?


Check the coupon area in the app and product pages for eligible offers, and confirm the exact savings in your order summary before you submit payment.


### How do I find discount codes on TikTok?


Find discount codes by opening TikTok Shop, browsing the official coupon page, and reviewing product listings for seller-funded promotions or codes to claim. The checkout summary may also display applicable offers. A code is only confirmed for your purchase when the order total updates before payment.


### What is the GIMME10 promo code?


GIMME10 is a promo code string that circulates online for TikTok Shop, but its validity depends on account eligibility, seller, minimum spend, and promotion dates. Test the code in the checkout field and check whether the discount appears in your order summary before completing payment.


### What is the TRIPLE10 promo code?


TRIPLE10 is another code string shared on social media for TikTok Shop savings, but no code is confirmed to work for every shopper. Review its stated terms in your account, enter it exactly as shown at checkout, and verify the final total reflects the discount before placing your order.


### Can I stack multiple promo codes on TikTok Shop?


Do not assume multiple codes will combine on TikTok Shop. Stacking depends on coupon terms and checkout rules, and a platform coupon may not combine with a seller discount. Test available offers in checkout, review which discount applies, and compare the final amount.


### Why is my TikTok Shop promo code not working?


A TikTok Shop promo code can fail because its terms do not match your cart, account, or purchase timing, such as minimum spend, eligible products, or expiration date. Read the checkout error message, confirm the code entry is exact, and check whether the offer is an automatically applied coupon instead.
